meta.note: This file is generated for this academic project, since no real data was provided for this category. It cross-references the exam pattern (internal/external weightage, exam months, backlog policy, revaluation) already established in academic_details_parul.json rather than restating it differently, and adds the specific process-level details requested here (schedule release, hall ticket process, result timeline, degree/transcript issuance) which weren't previously covered. None of this should be treated as officially confirmed university policy.

exam_schedule_release_process.release_channel: Exam schedules (date sheets) are published through the student ERP portal's examination module (already documented in technology_digital_services_parul_details.json), along with notice board postings at respective faculty offices.
exam_schedule_release_process.typical_timing: Schedules are generally released 2-3 weeks before the start of the examination period, consistent with the exam months already documented in academic_details_parul.json (November-December for odd semester, April-May for even semester).

hall_ticket_and_admit_card_process.eligibility_check: Hall tickets/admit cards are issued only after the university's automated eligibility check confirms the student has met the minimum attendance requirement (already documented in academic_details_parul.json's attendance policy) and has no pending fee dues.
hall_ticket_and_admit_card_process.download_process: Once eligible, students can download their hall ticket directly from the ERP portal's examination module, typically made available about one week before the exam period begins.
hall_ticket_and_admit_card_process.issue_resolution: Students who are unable to generate a hall ticket (due to attendance shortfall or fee dues) are directed to resolve the underlying issue (condonation application or fee clearance) before a hall ticket can be issued.

revaluation_and_rechecking_process.cross_reference: The core revaluation policy (window, fee) is already documented in academic_details_parul.json's 'exam_pattern.revaluation'.
revaluation_and_rechecking_process.application_process: Revaluation/photocopy requests are typically submitted through the ERP portal's examination module within the specified window (10-15 days after result declaration), along with the applicable per-subject fee.
revaluation_and_rechecking_process.outcome_timeline: Revised marks (if any change results from revaluation) are typically communicated within 3-4 weeks of the revaluation request being processed.

result_declaration_timeline.typical_timeline: Semester results are typically declared within 3-4 weeks of the last examination paper for that semester, published via the ERP portal.
result_declaration_timeline.provisional_vs_final: Results are usually first published as provisional (subject to any pending revaluation adjustments), with a formal semester grade card/transcript made available shortly after.

backlog_and_supplementary_exam_process.cross_reference: The core backlog policy (timing, fee) is already documented in academic_details_parul.json's 'exam_pattern.backlog_policy'.
backlog_and_supplementary_exam_process.application_process: Students with a backlog subject apply for the supplementary/backlog examination through the ERP portal during the designated backlog exam registration window, paying the applicable per-subject backlog exam fee.
backlog_and_supplementary_exam_process.repeated_backlog_note: Students with backlogs persisting across multiple attempts may be required to consult their faculty academic advisor regarding progression eligibility for the next academic year, consistent with standard Indian university practice.

degree_and_transcript_issuance_process.provisional_certificate: Upon successful completion of all semesters and final result declaration, students are issued a Provisional Certificate confirming degree completion, pending the formal Convocation ceremony (already documented in events_fests_cultural_calendar_parul_details.json).
degree_and_transcript_issuance_process.formal_degree: The formal degree certificate is conferred at the Convocation ceremony, or can be collected/couriered afterward for students unable to attend in person.
degree_and_transcript_issuance_process.transcript_requests: Official transcripts (for higher studies applications, visa purposes, or employer verification) can be requested through the ERP portal or the examination department office, typically processed within 1-2 weeks, consistent with the certificate processing timelines already referenced in fees_financial_aid_parul_details.json.
degree_and_transcript_issuance_process.duplicate_certificate_process: In case of a lost original certificate, students can apply for a duplicate degree/marksheet through the examination department, typically requiring an affidavit/police complaint copy and a processing fee, with a longer processing window than standard transcript requests.
